text:
kami: thinking out loud — we need a compact score envelope that keeps backward compatibility for mobile clients but lets us cut payloads in half. thoughts? :thinking:

dina: +1 on compacting. do we mean removing field names, or a versioned binary format?

sam: prefer versioned JSON first. binary/packed later. we need console telemetry to treat v2 differently for visualization/alerts.

kami: proposal: default v1 stays the same. v2 introduces a short-key map and an explicit `candidate_count` top-level field to avoid parsing big arrays. example: ```v1: {candidates:[{id,score,...}], meta:{}} v2: {n:10, c:["id,s,src"], m:{}}```

dina: hmm can we keep `score` semantics identical? (0-1 float vs logit). clients must not break. maybe require `score_type` enum in v2.

sam: yes add `score_type` with values {"prob","logit"}. console should normalize to probability for charts. add a telemetry tag `input_score_type` so dashboards know when conversions happened.

ops-bot: quota calc note: we charge per-candidate in routing. If v2 compresses payloads but still returns same candidate count, cost unchanged. if we add `n` to header we can short-circuit cost calc before parsing body (helps proxies).

eva: for Dedicated customers, we also route by model_affinity header. v2 should carry `model_hint` so we can route earlier. otherwise we waste fanout to multiple models.

mike: fallback behavior: if v2 request reaches a server that only understands v1, should be rejected with 415 and clear error message. we can't silently downgrade. need migration plan + rollout flag.

kami: agreed. rollout plan: gated canary via console (5% tenants) + telemetry to verify size savings and no score regressions. add a console toggle named `rerank.envelope.v2` that toggles parsing at ingress.

dina: small implementation note — keep streaming compatibility. some clients stream candidate batches. v2 must allow partial arrays or a `more` flag so streams still work.

sam: telemetry items to capture: candidate_count, avg_payload_bytes, model_hint used, score_type, conversion_count, rejected_v2_count. correlate with latency and error-rate.

eva: also add `dedicated.pool` hint so Dedicated infra can apply fast-paths. will add to infra PR.

mike: open question: do we allow mixed score types in one request? e.g., some candidates logits, some probs. i'd say no — make score_type request-scoped. simplifies normalization.

dina: +1 request-scoped. clients who mix should pre-normalize. document in api.md.

kami: i'll draft the API doc and a small compatibility test harness. I'll open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/742 (WIP) — please leave review notes focusing on payload shape, quota calc shortcuts, and console flags.

sam: tagging console/product for rollout UX: @product @console-team — we need a clean toggle, canary steps, and telemetry dashboards before enacting.

ops-bot: action items recorded: 1) api doc + spec 2) infra short-circuit using `n` header 3) console toggle `rerank.envelope.v2` 4) telemetry events listed above 5) compatibility tests.

kami: thanks all. i'll shepherd the PR and schedule a short sync if there are big concerns. :thumbsup:
